scope: Directed original-full-text reading of four specified papers and seed sections 2 and 6; no broad novelty search.
method: Official ACL PDF/metadata and explicit arXiv version HTML/metadata, read with the web tool; relevant equations, experiments and caveats checked.

sources.title: A Natural Bias for Language Generation Models
sources.critical_verified_detail: The unigram-initialized bias is trainable, not held fixed; Appendix A.6 reports little observed movement. Frequencies are estimated from tokenized training data. Output-projection scale is also discussed in Section 4.1.
sources.short_verbatim_evidence: We do not hold bias term parameters fixed during training
sources.coverage: Supports known unigram initialization intervention and interpretation; not a matched fixed-input frozen-versus-sign output factorial.

sources.title: Breaking the Softmax Bottleneck: A High-Rank RNN Language Model
sources.venue: ICLR Oral 2018, as listed on arXiv
sources.critical_verified_detail: The representability condition concerns the minimum rank over row-shifted log-probability matrices, assuming the stated universal approximator family. MoS mixes probabilities; mixing contexts before softmax retains the bottleneck.
sources.coverage: Prior theorem and MoS evidence do not directly determine finite-budget frozen-table versus sign-table interactions under a common unigram bias.

sources.title: Why do small language models underperform? Studying Language Model Saturation via the Softmax Bottleneck
sources.html_title_note: HTML uses the abbreviated subtitle Studying LM Saturation via the Softmax Bottleneck; metadata title above follows the arXiv abstract page.
sources.critical_verified_detail: The rank-constrained-head experiment freezes pretrained Transformer layers and retrains W=AB on about 150M Pile tokens. The asymptotic spectral-tail relation is a loose big-O result, not a contextual-NLL lower bound from a constant-unigram fit.
sources.coverage: Related low-rank head and saturation evidence; not the same intervention, training regime or six-condition diagnostic.
not_verified: Transfer of reported dimensional thresholds to this student

sources.title: Softmax Bottleneck Makes Language Models Unable to Represent Multi-mode Word Distributions
sources.critical_verified_detail: Theorems restrict selected rankings under explicit output-geometry conditions; approximate-dependence results additionally bound hidden-state magnitude. These statements are not a proof that every low-dimensional token fails to be argmax.
sources.coverage: Known geometry and multimode limitations plus MFS evidence; no matched frozen/sign output by common-unigram experiment found in the read sections.
not_verified: Applicability of theorem premises to actual project tables

sources.title: Embeddings Are Overpriced? A Frozen 16 MB Vocabulary for Small and Ternary Language Models
locators: Section 7, relation to Meister et al.
sources.critical_verified_detail: Arm B uses a fixed training-unigram prior; C trains it. Section 6 discloses a partial B2 trained-prior run and the body/schedule/prior confounds. These are author-disclosed limitations.
sources.coverage: The prior intervention is known; the read version does not establish the controlled continuous-trainable/continuous-frozen/sign-output by common-fixed-prior six-cell interaction.
not_verified: Each released checkpoint and optimizer state

mathematical_derivations.provenance: Elementary derivations for this project interface, not new theorems and not numerical results.
mathematical_derivations.notation: Column-vector convention: C in R^(V x k), P in R^(k x d), h in R^d, q=P h, logits=C q+b; k=d=128 for V0.1.
mathematical_derivations.fixed_table_space: Without independent vocabulary bias, logits belong to col(CP), a subset of col(C). final LayerNorm beta contributes CP beta in the same space.
mathematical_derivations.constant_distribution_condition: For free a and strictly positive pi: softmax(Ca+b)=pi iff log(pi)-b belongs to col(C)+span(1). For a constrained actual q, this is only necessary.
mathematical_derivations.hidden_width_limit: rank(CP)<=min(k,d); raising code width to 512 with d=128 does not remove the 128-dimensional contextual linear-readout limitation.
mathematical_derivations.argmax_distinction: With b=0 and free a, unique argmax v requires (c_v-c_u)^T a>0 for every other u. Distinct equal-norm sign rows provide a counterexample to inferring unargmaxability from low dimension: choose a=c_v. Actual row uniqueness and q reachability remain empirical questions.
mathematical_derivations.constant_fit_objective: L(a)=logsumexp(Ca)-pi^T Ca; L-H(pi)=KL(pi||softmax(Ca)); gradient C^T(q-pi); Hessian C^T(diag(q)-qq^T)C is PSD.
mathematical_derivations.prohibited_inference: The constant-unigram optimization residual is not a lower bound on contextual LM NLL. A fixed log(pi) changes information and the affine logit space together; its effect is not a unique causal identification of frequency.
